## Automatic fact checks (data only - YOU still write the explanation)

- Tiling vs naive over 18 matched configs: faster (>2 %) in 0, slower (>2 %) in 18, within +/-2 % in 0. Range 0.55x - 0.93x.
- Naive CUDA kernel-only speedup vs serial: 4.0x at N=128 -> 30.3x at N=4096; vs OpenMP: 3.5x -> 25.8x.
- GPU beats the OpenMP baseline (kernel-only) at every tested size.
- Naive best-shape bandwidth, 8 B/update model: 16 % - 84 % of the 320 GB/s peak (24 B model: 47 % - 252 %). A value above 100 % means the model over-counts DRAM traffic (cache reuse).
